chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Back in London in 1936: BBC television and records with Eddie Condon
summary: After the Ziegfeld show-girls revue in London they made the first BBC television broadcast and Columbia records with Eddie Condon, doing the same act.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: After that, see, we go to England to do the West End, then we come back doing the part with some of the people out of the show of the Ziegfeld Follies from "Transatlantic Rhythm," we come back in '36, that's the time we made the first broadcast for television on BBC, you know, in '36 and made recordings with Eddie Condon for Columbia Recording Company and we played all the cinemas over there.
What did you do on television?
That must have been new, different for you.
Why? I'd been doing the act for years.
But it was a different medium that you were going through. Did
No, because everything was just the way we were supposed to have it. Didn't feel funny at all.
